sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Very interesting! When the character is at the right edge (cols 50-51) and ACTION7 is pressed:
- The character stays at the right edge (doesn't move left)
- 9 green blocks appear in a 3x3 grid pattern!
Looking at the green block positions:
- Row 15: cols 27, 33, 39 (3 blocks in upper area)
- Row 33: cols 15, 21, 27 (3 blocks in middle area)
- Row 39: cols 15, 21, 27 (3 blocks in lower area)
This is a 3x3 grid of green blocks! And the character is now at the right edge.
So the game mechanic seems to be:
- ACTION7 at the LEFT edge: moves character to left edge (or stays there)
- ACTION7 at the RIGHT edge: spawns green blocks in a 3x3 pattern
- MOUSE: clicks green blocks to convert them to blue
But wait, the character stayed at the right edge after ACTION7. Previously when the character was at the right edge, ACTION7 moved it to the left edge. Let me check...
Actually, looking back:
- When character was at cols 20-21 (right side of lower area), ACTION7 moved it to cols 15-16 (left side)
- When character was at cols 50-51 (far right edge), ACTION7 kept it at cols 50-51 and spawned green blocks
So ACTION7 behavior depends on the character's position:
- At left/middle: moves character to left edge
- At right edge: spawns green blocks
But wait, the character was at cols 20-21 before and ACTION7 moved it to cols 15-16. But cols 20-21 is not the right edge. The right edge is cols 50-51. So:
- When character is NOT at the right edge: ACTION7 moves character to left edge
- When character IS at the right edge: ACTION7 spawns green blocks
This makes sense! The game mechanic is:
1. Move character to right edge with RIGHT
2. Press ACTION7 to spawn green blocks
3. Click green blocks with MOUSE to convert them to blue
4. Repeat until some goal is achieved
But what's the goal? Let me click all 9 green blocks and see if the level completes.
Actually, looking at the image, I see:
- 3 green blocks in the upper blue area (row ~15)
- 6 green blocks in the lower area (rows ~33 and ~39)
- The character is at the right edge
Let me click all 9 green blocks and see what happens.
